chatMessage.p0: Who sent the message. User renders a right-aligned accent bubble; assistant renders left-aligned plain text with no background. Also sets the entrance transform-origin.
chatMessage.p1: Message body. User messages render in the bubble; assistant messages render as plain text. Attachment-only messages show thumbnails only.
chatMessage.p2: Timestamp shown before actions in the hover-revealed meta row. User-message only; ignored on assistant replies.
chatMessage.p3: Icon-only action buttons shown next to the timestamp in the hover-revealed meta row.
chatMessage.p4: Optional attachments rendered as square thumbnails above the bubble.
chatMessage.p5: Side length, in pixels, of each attachment thumbnail.
chatMessage.p6: Merged onto the outer motion wrapper for max-width or spacing adjustments.
